arxiv-1910-02247.title: A Moving Mesh Method for Modelling Defects in Nematic Liquid Crystals
arxiv-1910-02247.creator: Craig S. MacDonald, John A. Mackenzie, Alison Ramage
arxiv-1910-02247.description: Abstract The properties of liquid crystals can be modelled using an order parameter which describes the variability of the local orientation of rod-like molecules. Defects in the director field can arise due to external factors such as applied electric or magnetic fields, or the constraining geometry of the cell containing the liquid crystal material.

arxiv-2103-05438.title: Electric Vector Potential Approach in Electrostatics : The Surface Electrode
arxiv-2103-05438.creator: Robert Salazar, Camilo Bayona-Roa, Gabriel Téllez
arxiv-2103-05438.description: Abstract Electric vector potential Θ ⁡ ( 𝒓 ) \Theta(\boldsymbol{r}) is a legitimate but rarely used tool to calculate the steady electric field in free-charge regions. Commonly, it is preferred to employ the scalar electric potential Φ ⁡ ( 𝒓 ) \Phi(\boldsymbol{r}) rather than Θ ⁡ ( 𝒓 ) \Theta(\boldsymbol{r}) in most of the electrostatic problems.

arxiv-2105-05623.title: Microscopic Derivation of Ginzburg–Landau Theory and the BCS Critical Temperature Shift in a Weak Homogeneous Magnetic Field
arxiv-2105-05623.creator: Andreas Deuchert, Christian Hainzl, Marcel Maier (born Schaub)
arxiv-2105-05623.description: Abstract Starting from the Bardeen–Cooper–Schrieffer (BCS) free energy functional, we derive the Ginzburg–Landau functional in the presence of a weak homogeneous magnetic field. We also provide an asymptotic formula for the BCS critical temperature as a function of the magnetic field.

arxiv-2112-12407.title: Directional Analytic Discrete Cosine Frames
arxiv-2112-12407.creator: Seisuke Kyochi, Taizo Suzuki, Yuichi Tanaka
arxiv-2112-12407.description: Abstract Block frames called directional analytic discrete cosine frames (DADCFs) are proposed for sparse image representation. In contrast to conventional overlapped frames, the proposed DADCFs require a reduced amount of 1) computational complexity, 2) memory usage, and 3) global memory access. These characteristics are strongly required for current high-resolution image processing.

arxiv-2508-00351.title: Cryptanalysis of Isogeny-Based Quantum Money with Rational Points
arxiv-2508-00351.creator: Hyeonhak Kim, Donghoe Heo, Seokhie Hong
arxiv-2508-00351.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hyeonhak Kim, Donghoe Heo, Seokhie Hong. Quantum money is the cryptographic application of the quantum no-cloning theorem. It has recently been instantiated by Montgomery and Sharif (Asiacrypt ’24) from class group actions on elliptic curves. In this work, we propose a concrete cryptanalysis by leveraging the efficiency of evaluating division polynomials with the coordinates of rational points, offering a speedup of O ⁡ ( log 4 ⁡ p ) O(\log^{4}p) compared to the brute-force attack.

arxiv-2508-08957.title: QAMRO: Quality-aware Adaptive Margin Ranking Optimization for Human-aligned Assessment of Audio Generation Systems
arxiv-2508-08957.creator: Chien-Chun Wang 1 , Kuan-Tang Huang 1 , Cheng-Yeh Yang 1 , Hung-Shin Lee 3 , Hsin-Min Wang 2 , and Berlin Chen 1
arxiv-2508-08957.description: Abstract Evaluating audio generation systems, including text-to-music (TTM), text-to-speech (TTS), and text-to-audio (TTA), remains challenging due to the subjective and multi-dimensional nature of human perception. Existing methods treat mean opinion score (MOS) prediction as a regression problem, but standard regression losses overlook the relativity of perceptual judgments.

arxiv-2509-24631.title: Capture and escape from the 2:1 resonance between Ariel and Umbriel in a fast-migration scenario of the Uranian system
arxiv-2509-24631.creator: M. Rossi, G. Lari, M. Falletta, C. Grassi, S.R.A. Gomes, M. Saillenfest
arxiv-2509-24631.description: Abstract Recent measurements and theoretical developments suggest that Uranus may exhibit a higher tidal dissipation than previously assumed. This enhanced dissipation leads to a faster orbital migration of its five major moons: Miranda, Ariel, Umbriel, Titania, and Oberon. Consequently, when studying their orbital evolution, resonant encounters that have always been discarded in previous works need to be included.

arxiv-2601-08344.title: Not so Swift: 20 years of multiwavelength observations of Mrk 421 and Mrk 501
arxiv-2601-08344.creator: Gabrielle L. Taylor ,, Stefan J. Wagner, Alicja Wierzcholska, Michael Zacharias
arxiv-2601-08344.description: Abstract Aims. The blazars Mrk 421 and Mrk 501 have shown multiwavelength variability on all observed timescales, and have been well studied at high energies on short timescales. We aim to characterise the long-term temporal behaviour of these blazars at synchrotron energies, namely optical, UV, and X-ray, in order to assess current models of these objects and their processes. pmc-10623625.description: BackgroundAllergic rhinitis (AR) has a significant impact on the community as a whole with regard to quality of life and its relationship to allergic multi-morbidities. Appropriate diagnosis, treatment and review of the efficacy of interventions can ameliorate these effects. Yet, the importance of AR is often overlooked, and appropriate therapy is neglected.

pmc-11356854.title: Synthesis and Characterization of Transition Metal Complexes Supported by Phosphorus Ligands Obtained Using Hydrophosphination of Cyclic Internal Alkenes
pmc-11356854.creator: Victoria Mechrouk, Damien Bissessar, Julien Egly, Jordan Parmentier, Stéphane Bellemin-Laponnaz, Miquel Barceló-Oliver, Juan Niclós-Gutiérrez
pmc-11356854.description: The design and study of rich, bulky phosphorus ligands is a key area of research for homogeneous catalysis. Here, we describe an original strategy using a hydrophosphination reaction to produce phosphines of interest for coordination chemistry and homogenous catalysis. In particular, the phosphine obtained by reacting diphenylphosphine with acenaphthylene (ligand 2) gives a ligand that adopts an unusual spatial geometry.

pmc-11404908.title: Free Vascularized Osseous Fibula Flap for Vertebral Body Defect in a Patient with Tuberculosis Spondylitis

pmc-11404908.description: Summary:In the context of tuberculous spondylitis, a rare form of extrapulmonary tuberculosis causing significant discomfort and neurological deficits, surgery becomes imperative to alleviate symptoms alongside antituberculosis treatment. However, the utilization of free vascularized fibula flaps for repairing vertebral deformities remains uncommon.

pmc-12472195.title: Proteomic Research of the Stress Response of Saccharomyces cerevisiae W303 Yeast to Metal Ions Eluted from Orthodontic Appliances

pmc-12472195.description: Although orthodontic appliances are widely used in daily practice, they also have their downsides due to the large amount of metal ions released from their surface. pmc-13084933.title: Association between indoor air pollution and risk of oesophageal cancer: a Chinese population-based case–control study
pmc-13084933.creator: Kuangyu Liu, Zi-Yi Jin, Fang Fang, Jin-Yi Zhou, Mia Hashibe, Jianyu Rao, Hua Zhou, Xing Liu, Liming Li, Lina Mu, Ming Wu, Jin-Kou Zhao, Zuo-Feng Zhang
pmc-13084933.description: IntroductionOesophageal cancer is a highly lethal malignancy with geographic disparity and a heavy burden in developing countries. While smoking and alcohol are established risk factors, emerging evidence suggests that indoor air pollution (IAP) may also play a role through the inhalation of aerosols along the aerodigestive tract, but its relationship with oesophageal cancer remains poorly understood.
